notationDecision.asrTranscript: This is a notice for teams using the North Laboratory Building. Electrical maintenance will interrupt power on the second floor from 6 to 9 on Saturday morning. The sample freezers are connected to a separate backup circuit and will remain powered. However, the small refrigerators beside individual workstations are not on that circuit. Move any temperature-sensitive materials from those refrigerators into approved storage by Friday afternoon and label them with your team name. Do not move freezer contents unless the laboratory supervisor asks you to. Building access cards will continue to work, but lifts will be unavailable during the interruption. The maintenance team will email an all clear notice after testing is complete. The scheduled end time alone is not permission to restart sensitive equipment.
